brief:
Tens of thousands of people dressed in red filled the streets of Amsterdam on Sunday to protest ongoing violence against Palestinians in Gaza, Al-Monitor reported. Demonstrators carried signs reading "Stop the Genocide" as part of the show of support.

The Dutch capital has hosted several major pro-Palestinian demonstrations in recent months as the conflict in Gaza continues to draw international attention and activism across Europe.
dek: Tens of thousands of people dressed in red thronged the streets of Amsterdam on Sunday to denounce ongoing violence against Palestinians in Gaza, carrying signs reading "Stop the Genocide".
title: Tens of thousands march through Amsterdam for Gaza
